name: creative-model-bridge
description: Route creative writing requests to a configured Responses API provider with auditable prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Use configured creative models through a transparent MCP bridge.
interface.longDescription: Builds deterministic prompts from the requested task and supplied materials, previews the exact outbound payload, lists models from the configured Responses provider, and returns generated text verbatim with request metadata.
defaultPrompt: List the creative models configured for this device.
Generate a draft using the exact model I name.
